---
title: "Carolinian Dictionary Additional Checks"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

df <- read_tsv("../outputs/carolinian_combined.tsv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) replace_na(x, "")))

cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows from combined TSV\n")

stage1_dir <- "../outputs/stage-1"
tsv_files <- tibble(path = list.files(stage1_dir, pattern = "page_.*_stage1\\.tsv$",
                                       recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(page = str_extract(path, "page_\\d+"),
         page_num = as.integer(str_extract(page, "\\d+"))) |>
  arrange(page_num)

cat("Found", nrow(tsv_files), "Stage 1 TSV files\n")
```

## Check 1: Variant forms — extract from Stage 1 and cross-reference against TSV

```{r check1_extract}
extract_headword <- function(text) {
  m <- str_match(str_trim(text), "^<b>([^<]+)</b>")
  if (!is.na(m[1, 2])) str_trim(m[1, 2]) else NA_character_
}

extract_variants <- function(text) {
  m <- str_match(text, "\\(or <i>([^<]+)</i>\\)")
  if (is.na(m[1, 2])) return(character(0))
  str_trim(str_split(m[1, 2], ",")[[1]]) |> str_remove("\\.$")
}

ground_truth <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(tsv_files))) {
  page <- tsv_files$page[i]
  stage1_df <- read_tsv(tsv_files$path[i], col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                        na = character()) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), \(x) replace_na(x, "")))
  current_hw <- NA_character_
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(stage1_df))) {
    text <- str_trim(stage1_df$text[j])
    if (text == "") next
    hw <- extract_headword(text)
    if (!is.na(hw)) current_hw <- hw
    if (!is.na(current_hw)) {
      variants <- extract_variants(text)
      if (length(variants) > 0) {
        if (!is.null(ground_truth[[current_hw]])) {
          ground_truth[[current_hw]]$variants <- c(ground_truth[[current_hw]]$variants, variants)
        } else {
          ground_truth[[current_hw]] <- list(variants = variants, page = page)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("Found", length(ground_truth), "headwords with variant forms in Stage 1\n")
```

```{r check1_compare}
tsv_variants <- df |> select(Headword, Variant_Form) |> deframe()

issues <- map_dfr(names(ground_truth), function(headword) {
  stage1_variants <- ground_truth[[headword]]$variants
  tsv_str <- tsv_variants[[headword]] %||% ""
  tsv_set <- str_trim(str_split(tsv_str, ",")[[1]])
  missing <- setdiff(stage1_variants, tsv_set)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    tibble(
      Page = ground_truth[[headword]]$page,
      Headword = headword,
      Stage1_Variants = paste(sort(stage1_variants), collapse = ", "),
      TSV_Variant_Form = tsv_str,
      Missing_in_TSV = paste(sort(missing), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
})

cat("Flagged:", nrow(issues), "headwords with variant forms not fully captured in TSV\n")
if (nrow(issues) > 0) print(issues)
```

## Check 2: Dialect-marked headwords — extract from Stage 1 and cross-reference against TSV

```{r check2_extract}
DIALECT_PATTERN <- "^<b>([^<]+)</b>\\s*\\((TAN|EL|LN|S)\\)"

dialect_headwords <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(tsv_files))) {
  page <- tsv_files$page[i]
  stage1_df <- read_tsv(tsv_files$path[i], col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                        na = character()) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), \(x) replace_na(x, "")))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(stage1_df))) {
    text <- str_trim(stage1_df$text[j])
    if (text == "") next
    m <- str_match(text, regex(DIALECT_PATTERN, ignore_case = TRUE))
    if (!is.na(m[1, 1])) {
      hw <- str_trim(m[1, 2])
      dialect <- str_to_upper(m[1, 3])
      dialect_headwords[[hw]] <- list(dialect = dialect, page = page)
    }
  }
}

cat("Found", length(dialect_headwords), "dialect-marked headwords in Stage 1\n")
by_dialect <- map_chr(dialect_headwords, "dialect") |> table()
for (d in names(by_dialect)) cat(" ", d, ":", by_dialect[[d]], "headwords\n")
```

```{r check2_compare}
tsv_dialect <- df |> select(Headword, Dialect) |> deframe()

issues <- map_dfr(names(dialect_headwords), function(headword) {
  expected <- dialect_headwords[[headword]]$dialect
  actual <- tsv_dialect[[headword]] %||% ""
  if (!str_detect(actual, fixed(expected))) {
    tibble(
      Page = dialect_headwords[[headword]]$page,
      Headword = headword,
      Expected_Dialect = expected,
      TSV_Dialect = if (actual == "") "(empty)" else actual
    )
  }
})

cat("Flagged:", nrow(issues), "dialect-marked headwords not correctly captured in Dialect column\n")
if (nrow(issues) > 0) print(issues) else cat("All dialect-marked headwords correctly captured.\n")
```

## Check 3: Hallucination check — headwords vs English-Carolinian finderlist

```{r check3_load}
finderlist <- read_tsv("finderlist.tsv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                       na = character()) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) replace_na(x, "")))
valid_headwords <- str_to_lower(str_trim(finderlist$carolinian_headword)) |> unique()
cat("Loaded", length(valid_headwords), "unique Carolinian headwords from finderlist\n")
```

```{r check3_check}
MATCH_THRESHOLD <- 0.70

is_variant <- str_starts(str_trim(df$Gloss), "Variant of") |
              (str_trim(df$Variant_Form) != "" & str_trim(df$Gloss) == "")
df_check <- df[!is_variant, ]

results <- df_check |>
  group_by(Source_Page) |>
  summarise(
    Total_Headwords = n(),
    Matched = sum(str_to_lower(str_trim(Headword)) %in% valid_headwords),
    Unmatched = Total_Headwords - Matched,
    Match_Rate = round(Matched / Total_Headwords, 2),
    Unmatched_Headwords = paste(Headword[!str_to_lower(str_trim(Headword)) %in% valid_headwords],
                                collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Flagged = Match_Rate < MATCH_THRESHOLD) |>
  arrange(Match_Rate)

flagged <- results |> filter(Flagged)
cat("Flagged:", nrow(flagged), "pages with match rate below",
    scales::percent(MATCH_THRESHOLD), "\n")
if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
  print(flagged |> select(Source_Page, Total_Headwords, Matched, Unmatched, Match_Rate, Unmatched_Headwords))
}
```

## Check 4: Finderlist headwords containing non-Carolinian characters

```{r check4}
ALLOWED_CHARS <- c("a", "á", "b", "c", "d", "e", "é", "f", "g", "h",
                   "i", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "ó", "p", "r", "s",
                   "t", "u", "ú", "w", "y", "z",
                   "-", " ", "1", "2", "3", "–", "—", "¹", "²", "³")  # allow hyphen, space, superscript digits

finderlist2 <- read_tsv("finderlist.tsv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                        na = character()) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) replace_na(x, "")))

flagged <- finderlist2 |>
  mutate(
    chars = str_extract_all(str_to_lower(carolinian_headword), "."),
    unexpected = map_chr(chars, \(ch) paste(unique(ch[!ch %in% ALLOWED_CHARS]), collapse = " "))
  ) |>
  filter(unexpected != "") |>
  select(page_number, carolinian_headword, unexpected, english_word, dialect)

cat("Flagged:", nrow(flagged), "headwords with non-Carolinian characters\n")
if (nrow(flagged) > 0) print(flagged)

# Also show all unique unexpected characters across the full finderlist
all_chars <- str_extract_all(str_to_lower(finderlist2$carolinian_headword), ".") |>
  unlist() |>
  unique() |>
  sort()
unexpected_chars <- all_chars[!all_chars %in% ALLOWED_CHARS]
cat("\nAll unexpected characters found:", paste(unexpected_chars, collapse = " "), "\n")
```
